author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read IBM MaaS360 portal audit data from the administrator login report and the administrator changes audit. The example bridge in bridges/ibm-maas360 pulls the records and posts them to HTTP Ingest. Administrator logins go to Auth and changes to administrator accounts go to ManagementEvent.
notes:
Setup:
- MaaS360 has no syslog or webhook for portal audit data, so these parsers read records pulled by the example bridge in bridges/ibm-maas360 from the MaaS360 administrator login report and administrator changes audit and posted to HTTP Ingest.
- The bridge names each record in maas360_record.

Field mapping:
- Administrator logins go to Auth and changes to administrator accounts (roles added or removed, account status) go to ManagementEvent.
- IBM describes the login status as success or failure; the public examples show Successful or an empty value, so any status with fail in it counts as a failed login.

Time:
- Times are epoch milliseconds.

Sources and licenses:
- IBM's per-endpoint API reference is inside the MaaS360 Portal, so the record shapes come from IBM's report descriptions and the MIT-licensed Cortex XSOAR MaaS360 collector.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in those shapes.

Testing:
- Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13, and the parent's confirm string picked the same records there.
- On 2026-10-14 each child also passed Run Test in a lab tenant as a separate parser under its parent.
- No built-in parser in that tenant matched these records.

Known gaps:
- Device compliance and device action records aren't covered.
